name: Coffee Cream
description: Historical recipe from The Virginia Housewife; Or, Methodical Cook (1824). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: rich, perfectly sweet milk
ingredients.originalText: one quart rich, perfectly sweet milk

instructions.text: Toast two gills of raw coffee till it is a light brown, and not a grain burnt
Put it hot from the toaster without grinding it, into a quart of rich, and perfectly sweet milk
Boil it, and add the yelks of eight eggs
When done, strain it through a sieve, and sweeten it
If properly done, it will not be discoloured

source.author: Mary Randolph
source.originalInstructions:
1. Toast two gills of raw coffee till it is a light brown, and not a grain burnt
2. Put it hot from the toaster without grinding it, into a quart of rich, and perfectly sweet milk
3. Boil it, and add the yelks of eight eggs
4. When done, strain it through a sieve, and sweeten it
5. If properly done, it will not be discoloured
originalIngredients: one quart rich, perfectly sweet milk
